seoTitle: Psybeam — Live Voice Translator for Travel
metaDescription: Two people, one phone, no app on their end. Hold your button and they hear you in their language; hold theirs and you hear their reply in yours. 22 languages, spoken aloud both ways. Start with free minutes, no subscription.
heroHeadline: Hold up your phone. They don't touch it.
heroSubhead: Psybeam is a real-time voice interpreter for travel: you hold the phone and run both sides of the conversation. Hold your button and speak — they hear it aloud in their language. Hold theirs while they answer — you hear it in yours. The stranger in front of you never touches your phone.
highlights: No account and no subscription to start
Your transcript stays on your device

features.title: Two thumb buttons
features.body: One button for your language, one for theirs. Hold to speak, release to send. You run both sides of the conversation from a single phone.

features.title: Voice to voice
features.body: Natural speech-to-speech that follows the speaker's own voice. No typing, no reading a script, no teaching anyone the app.

features.title: Always faces them
features.body: Your words, in their language, rotate to face the person opposite you. Their reply stays upright for you to read.

features.title: Local language by GPS
features.body: Cross a border and Psybeam suggests the local language from your location, so you start talking instead of digging through menus.

features.title: Pay per minute
features.body: Start with free minutes, then buy a pack only when you need more. No recurring charge and no trial trap.

features.title: Private by design
features.body: Audio is streamed to OpenAI only to translate it. OpenAI does not use it to train models, though it may briefly retain API audio for abuse monitoring. Your transcript never leaves your phone.

howItWorks.body: Launch Psybeam and it goes straight to talking, no account or sign-up required.
Press your button and talk; Psybeam says it aloud in their language, then they hold their button to reply.
You hear their answer in your own language, face to face, in seconds.

faq.a: Psybeam is free to download and starts you with 5 free minutes. After that you buy a one-time minute pack, starting at $4.99, only when you need more. There is no subscription and no recurring charge.

faq.q: Do I need to create an account?
faq.a: No. Psybeam opens straight to talking with no sign-up. You can sign in with Apple later to link your account, but it is never required to use the app.

faq.q: Does the other person need the app?
faq.a: No. You hold the phone and run both sides. The person you are talking to just listens, then speaks when it is their turn, with an on-screen prompt inviting them in their own language.

faq.q: How many languages does it support?
faq.a: 22 languages, spoken aloud in both directions: Arabic, Chinese, Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Turkish and Vietnamese.

Your conversation transcript stays on your phone and is never uploaded anywhere. To translate your speech, the audio itself is streamed to OpenAI in real time; OpenAI does not use that audio to train its models, though like any API traffic it may be retained briefly for abuse monitoring. Psybeam's own servers never see or store your audio or transcript.
No. Live voice translation needs a connection, since the speech is translated in real time by a cloud translator.

faq.q: Which devices does it run on?
faq.a: Psybeam runs on iPhone with iOS 18 and later.

faq.q: Can I get a refund on unused minutes?
faq.a: Minute packs are handled through the App Store, so refunds follow Apple's standard purchase support process. There is no subscription to cancel.
